per_step_diagnostics.data_source: each new run accepted_ark_w_step_N.csv, existing producer; never substitute E307 per-step values
per_step_diagnostics.call_and_state_gates: same accepted Yi checked-state arrays, physical owners 4096; FI/Full available metadata and auxiliary reference/context source policy, stage1 explicit/independentFull unavailable; stage4 returned-K remains independently unknown if absent
per_step_diagnostics.units: G_W in m/s; K-FI in m/s^2; signed measured/source-derived-top pressure/buoyancy powers in W and dt*tableau work in J
per_step_diagnostics.summary: each accepted step: G_W and K-FI RMS/max per implicit stage, direct-increment norm bound h sum|b|*RMS(K-FI); pressure and buoyancy power/weighted work summaries; actual raw/projected W increment/replay defects
per_step_diagnostics.implementation: reuse tools/analyze_accepted_ark_w_stage.py analytical equations/reader with existing exact e71 statics and same-call captures; export compact rows and endpoints as primary results

additional_source_context.no_reinterpretation: negative quadratic defect is a defined work-quadrature diagnostic, not true-energy error or an identified damping rate

fixed_diagnostic_trigger.meaning: fixed descriptive trigger only; it is not a reference qualification, acceptance target, or error bound; report per-time exceedance without pass/fail language

forbidden_inferences: frequency or oscillation identification from this comparison
causality of the observed W difference

frozen_direction.definition: Use these exact frozen arrays without recomputing or adjusting direction or mass weights.

metrics.primary: At all 17 common times, compute coarse/fine W and delta=fine-coarse on the 4096 physical owners: unweighted RMS/max-abs, M0-weighted RMS, cosine(delta,coarse W) when both norms are nonzero, signed p_coarse/p_fine/p_delta=sum(M0*W*e1)/sum(M0), and parallel/perpendicular M0-weighted RMS relative to e1.
metrics.raw_arrays: Save coarse/fine/delta W trajectories, owner mask, M0 weights, a0, e1 and projections in one compressed NPZ.
metrics.sign_convention: fine minus coarse for delta and signed projection
metrics.zero_norm_policy: cosine is null if either vector norm is zero; projection remains signed and finite

optional_regression.reason: omit pair-fitted amplitude/derivative directions; retain the pre-run fixed spatial projection, trajectory norms and cosines only

physical_w_ownership.crop: W[1:,:,:] removes fixed lower face; keep top dynamic face; horizontal mask is physical 16x16 and excludes packed periodic closing row/column
physical_w_ownership.source: tools/benchmark_wrf_accuracy_cost.py::_owned and PR307 accepted-stage v2 physical-owner metadata, crosschecked to the pinned input NetCDF

scope: same-case W trajectory comparison for h=0.9375 s (16 steps) and h=0.46875 s (32 steps), 0-15 s; descriptive diagnostics only

time_alignment.initial_gate: physical W owner values at t=0 must be bitwise identical after FP32 view
time_alignment.timestamp_join: exact rational elapsed times from contiguous accepted CSV step_seq and each actual dt; coarse j matches fine 2*j. WRF Times is checked only at t0 and t15; 19-character Times cannot distinguish subsecond endpoints.
time_alignment.primary_endpoints: projected_final internal FP64 W arrays per accepted step; t0 from first input, require all six initial prognostic vectors exact-equal across runs. Separately compare t0/t15 NetCDF FP32 publication after correct conversion.

detail_interval_selection.primary: first common endpoint j>0 with unweighted RMS(fine-coarse)>fixed epsilon_W/3 selects [t_(j-1),t_j] and the corresponding one coarse/two fine step capture(s)
detail_interval_selection.fallback: if no crossing, select final [14.0625,15] seconds; label fixed final-interval fallback, not acceptance or first growth
detail_interval_selection.no_reexecution: selected detail comes from the already saved captures; no added model call

raw_capture_storage.source_format: existing full CSV written temporarily; all raw CSV bytes preserved via lossless zstd-1 with source/decompressed SHA256 verification
raw_capture_storage.primary_review_artifacts: compact FP64 W trajectories at all accepted endpoints, per-step scalar summaries, 17 common-time comparisons, fixed basis and selected detail captures
raw_capture_storage.raw_archive_scope: full compressed raw captures retained separately; a smaller review bundle may include compact arrays, inputs/scripts and selected one coarse/two fine detail captures without duplicating every full CSV
